title: Types of Connections
markdown:
Connections between devices fall into two broad categories:

1. **Point-to-Point** — A dedicated link between exactly two devices. The entire capacity of the link is reserved for those two devices. *Example: A TV remote control sending a signal to a television.*
2. **Multipoint** (also called *multidrop*) — A connection in which more than two devices share a single link. The channel capacity is shared, either spatially or temporally. *Example: Multiple terminals connected to a mainframe via a shared bus.*
